## Barbell Back Squat - Spotting Technique with One Spotter

- Stand behind the athlete at a point where they will back out from the rack (-13)
- Step up to the athlete after they have set their stance, set feet slightly wider than theirs, and position arms under the athlete's armpits, next to their side (-14)
- As the athlete descends, descend in unison keeping arms under their armpits without touching (-15)
- As the athlete ascends, ascend in unison keeping arms under their armpits without touching (-16)
